## Maintainer ruling recorded — **C-deny, now**: a text operator (`$contains` / `$notContains` / `$startsWith` / `$endsWith` / `$icontains` / `$like` / `$ilike`) over a field whose DECLARED type can never store a string — `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES` ∪ `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES` ∪ `CALENDAR_DATE_TYPES` ∪ `INSTANT_TYPES` ∪ `CLOCK_TIME_TYPES` ∪ `STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES`, all existing sets in `field-value.zod.ts` — is refused at the engine's field-aware door with `INVALID_FILTER` 400 naming the field and its declared type. No new vocabulary is minted. String-valued classes (`STRING_VALUE_TYPES`, `autonumber`, option codes, reference ids) pass. `formula` is judged only when its declared return type is readable at the seam. #14079's option-A row stays beneath the door for every evaluator no door fronts.

Director seat, summon #14, session `session_01LsEjuNMPitCHwEfYftZ1um` (GitHub `os-warren`), 2026-09-05. Provenance: maintainer, live PM chat, decision batch #43 (item 5, presented with the director's recommendation C-deny now — stated as differing from the filing seat's recommendation D-first — and 「同意」 adopts C-deny), verbatim reply 「同意」. Premise: the card body (spec seat, 02:03Z) — the vocabulary the door needs already exists as declared value classes; the door precedent is the comparand `door-refusal` rows and the engine's `INVALID_FIELD` door; the only real producer (global search) already refuses at its own door; batch #39 ruled #14079 = A and deferred C to this card.

**Ruled: C-deny.** Not taken: C-allow (would break substring filters over `select` codes, lookup ids and tags that work today), D (leaves the "silent wrong answer" the conformance file's own header names).

**Why (① ≥50%):** a narrowing of the accept set that reuses declared value classes and the door shape already running on two neighbouring seams — no new public surface; ③ the deciding facet on a cell whose only real occurrence is a mistake: `[]` with no signal becomes a 400 that names the field's declared type; ② zero pull, so the door must cost no vocabulary — it does not; ④ one door, no configuration.

**Execution, two lanes, contract-first:** (1) `domain:spec` — `door-refusal` rows for the refused classes in `filter-comparand-type-conformance.ts` or a same-shaped sibling table, referencing the existing sets (⛔ no new set), plus the `formula`-deferred note (`Clause-②: yes`, `@objectstack/spec` **minor** + BREAKING banner: a text operator over a numeric/boolean/temporal/JSON field is now refused at the engine door instead of answering `[]` or a dialect accident). (2) `domain:engine` — the door in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` beside `INVALID_FIELD`, judged against the object's real field map, before any driver dispatch; pins per refused class and per passing class, and the direct-driver path still answering #14079's A row (`@objectstack/objectql` **minor**). Sequencing: after PR(s) for #14079 land. Zone 2 (report, not block): whether objectui's filter builder emits such conditions today (the seat cannot measure host apps; say so).

State transition, same stroke: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. `domain:spec` unchanged; priority is triage's to set (director's reading: p3 — no incident, a loud-vs-silent question). Ledger: director seat post #12708, batch #43. Related: #14079 · `filter-comparand-type-conformance.ts` · `search-fields.ts`.

Sequencing satisfied: #14079's PR #15686 landed at 05:02Z (`a646120dc`). **Lane (2), the engine door itself, is NOT in this dispatch**: it is filed as its own engine-lane card (linked below, `Blocked-by: #15661`, contract-first) — this seat does not dispatch into `packages/objectql`.

**Seat readings (`origin/main` `b25a5fc32`, 2026-09-05T07:11Z)**: the comparand table's `door-refusal` shape (`filter-comparand-type-conformance.ts:26`, `:113-120`, 12 rows) asserts `parseFilterAST(filter)` throws — a syntax-level door; the ruled door is FIELD-aware (declared type), so the rows most likely live in a same-shaped sibling keyed on the declared type class, consumable the way `packages/objectql/src/engine-comparand-type-door.test.ts` consumes the comparand table. #14079's landed `NON_TEXT_STORED_VALUE_TYPES` (numeric + boolean) is the SQL faces' type-gate set and stays beneath the door untouched.

**File face**: one new (or extended) conformance table + test under `packages/spec/src/data/`, regenerated `packages/spec/api-surface/data.json` / `export-origins/data.json` / docs references (new export; ⛔ never hand-edited), one changeset. ⛔ Not touched: `field-value.zod.ts` (the sets are referenced, not changed), `filter-text-conformance.ts`, every driver, `packages/objectql/**`, `packages/services/**`, `migrations/registry.ts` (held). Hot-file check against the lane's in-flight dispatches (#14972 `system/i18n-resolver.ts`, #15430 `automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts` + `shared/expression.zod.ts`) and the landing PRs (#15707, #15716): no intersection; the generated `data/` shard is shared and lands serially (regen merge before the PR if another PR regenerates it first).

Dedup handed to the dev (MCP `search_issues` 2026-09-05T07:12Z, 10 results: #15661 the in-set control; #15684 (services, LIKE case-fold), #13744 / #7534 / #6337 / #6518 / #6444 / #5240 closed and different): no engine-door card exists — filed by this seat as the lane-(2) card in this stroke.

8. `NON_TEXT_STORED_VALUE_TYPES` (numeric + boolean) stays narrower than the door's set on purpose, pinned (H4). ✓
